opinion.content: We think Xu Xiake is good. We like him because he called for peeople to take care of nature. We can learn to take care of nature like him.
opinion.comment: 整体很棒哦！只有一处小拼写错误，把“peeople”改成“people”就更完美啦，句子贴合主题，继续加油！

opinion.content: We think he is good. We like him because he called people to tak care of nature. We learn to care of like him.
opinion.comment: 你的观点很清晰哦！有两处小失误：一是“take care of”的“take”少写了字母e；二是第三句短语不对，应该用“take care of”，可改成“We can learn to take care of nature like him.”，继续加油！

opinion.content: We think he is good. We like him because like nature. We can learn to take care of nature like him.
opinion.comment: 你写的内容很贴合主题！第一个句子没问题，第二句想表达喜欢的原因，可补充主语改成“We like him because we love nature.”更通顺。第三句的“take care of nature”很棒，句子完整，继续加油！
